text: Do 15 pushups or take 5 sips. For every pushup you can't do, add a sip.
Hold a plank for 30 seconds or take 4 sips.
Let someone go through your camera roll for 30 seconds or take 5 sips.
Do your best TikTok dance. Group votes: fail = 3 sips, pass = give out 3.
Balance a cup on your head for 10 seconds or take 2 sips.
Text your mom 'I love you' and show the response, or take 3 sips.
Name 10 countries in 15 seconds. Each one you miss = 1 sip.
Let the group post something on your Instagram story or take 4 sips.
Staring contest with the person across from you. Loser takes 3 sips.
Do your best runway walk across the room or take 2 sips.
NEW RULE: Anytime someone checks their phone, they take a sip.
Arm wrestle the person to your right. Loser takes 4 sips.
Speak only in questions until the next card. Statements = sip.
Do 20 jumping jacks or take 3 sips.
Call a friend and tell them you love them on speaker, or take 4 sips.
Say the alphabet backwards. Every mistake = 1 sip.
Let someone send a text from your phone (group approves the message) or take 5 sips.
Hold your drink with your pinky out until the next card. Forget = sip.
Impressions battle! Do 3 impressions. Group picks winner, loser drinks.
Post the 3rd photo in your camera roll or take 4 sips.
Touch your toes for 15 seconds or take 2 sips.
Go live on any social media for 30 seconds or take 5 sips.
Recite the lyrics to a song chosen by the group or take 3 sips.
NEW RULE: You must stand when drinking. Forget = extra sip.
Speed round: Name 5 types of cheese in 10 seconds or take 3 sips.
Keep a straight face while others try to make you laugh for 30 sec. Laugh = 3 sips.
Do a handstand (or attempt one) or take 4 sips.
Let someone style your hair however they want for the rest of the game or take 3 sips.
Say a tongue twister 3 times fast. Fail = 3 sips. Pass = give out 3.
Take a shot or chug your drink for 5 seconds.
NEW RULE: Respond to questions with 'absolutely' instead of yes. Forget = sip.
Balance on one foot for 20 seconds while everyone tries to distract you. Fall = 3 sips.
Speed round: Name 7 fruits in 10 seconds. Miss = 1 sip each.
FaceTime a random contact and say 'wrong number' or take 4 sips.
Switch shirts with someone for the next 3 rounds or take 5 sips.
Do a dramatic death scene. Group rates 1-10. Under 6 = drink the difference.
Thumb war with the person to your left. Loser takes 2 sips.
Yell something embarrassing out the window or take 4 sips.
Say 'sip' out loud every time you take a sip until next card. Forget = extra sip.
Freestyle rap for 20 seconds. Group votes: fire = give out 3, trash = take 3.
